notes: Original binary documents are canonical on Google Drive regardless of file size.
Human Viewer routing never changes the factual Source of Truth.
PDF files at or above 25 MiB use Adobe PDF Embed API when size metadata and Adobe credentials are available.
If Adobe initialization or rendering fails, the viewer falls back to Google Drive Preview.
PPTX continues to use Google Drive Preview even when the file is large.
The supplemental CEDEC 2026 catalog contains 54 canonical Drive URLs.
